hunin/profile-inspection.clock: Only explicitly aligned sample timestamps participate in windows; unaligned_count is excluded selected-unit sample count.
hunin/profile-inspection.window: Inclusive start/end bounds; both must be supplied together. A sample at a bin boundary belongs to the following bin, except the capture/window endpoint belongs to the final bin.
hunin/profile-inspection.selected_weight: Self/leaf weight of frame_id. Selection evidence and observed extent include any stack occurrence, once per sample.
hunin/profile-inspection.identity: Function ids identify function/file/module/code_id. Tree node ids identify an entire call path; frame_id links a node to its function.
hunin/profile-inspection.scope: All calculations and result_identity use one selected-observation transaction. Limits truncate display rows/tree only; totals remain complete within the enforced query budget.
hunin/profile-inspection.caller_weights: Each distinct immediate-caller identity is counted once per matching sample. Recursive occurrences may expose multiple caller rows for one sample; caller weights are overlapping, not a partition.
hunin/profile-inspection.outside_window: An explicit start/end pair is returned unchanged, including outside-capture empty windows. Missing aligned data has null bounds/window and weights; an empty window within a known capture has observed zero weight.
